mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE down(snapshot_id, node_type, ref, parent_ref, ordinal, title, level, block_type, d) AS ( SELECT n.snapshot_id, n.node_type, n.ref, n.parent_ref, n.ordinal, n.title, n.level, n.block_type, 1 FROM asset_structure_nodes n WHERE n.snapshot_id = #{snapshotId} AND n.parent_ref = #{rootRef} UNION ALL SELECT n.snapshot_id, n.node_type, n.ref, n.parent_ref, n.ordinal, n.title, n.level, n.block_type, down.d + 1 FROM asset_structure_nodes n JOIN down ON n.snapshot_id = down.snapshot_id AND n.parent_ref = down.ref WHERE down.d < #{maxDepth} ) SELECT snapshot_id, node_type, ref, parent_ref, ordinal, title, level, block_type FROM down ORDER BY d ASC, ordinal ASC NULLS LAST, ref ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

WITH RECURSIVE up(snapshot_id, node_type, ref, parent_ref, ordinal, title, level, block_type, d) AS ( SELECT n.snapshot_id, n.node_type, n.ref, n.parent_ref, n.ordinal, n.title, n.level, n.block_type, 1 FROM asset_structure_nodes n WHERE n.snapshot_id = #{snapshotId} AND n.ref = (SELECT p.parent_ref FROM asset_structure_nodes p WHERE p.snapshot_id = #{snapshotId} AND p.ref = #{ref}) UNION ALL SELECT n.snapshot_id, n.node_type, n.ref, n.parent_ref, n.ordinal, n.title, n.level, n.block_type, up.d + 1 FROM asset_structure_nodes n JOIN up ON n.snapshot_id = up.snapshot_id AND n.ref = up.parent_ref WHERE up.d < #{maxDepth} ) SELECT snapshot_id, node_type, ref, parent_ref, ordinal, title, level, block_type FROM up ORDER BY d ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM asset_structure_nodes WHERE snapshot_id = #{snapshotId} AND node_type = #{nodeType}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM asset_structure_edges WHERE snapshot_id = #{snapshotId} AND relation = #{relation}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM asset_raw_segments WHERE document_snapshot_id = #{snapshotId}

SELECT r.structural_context FROM asset_retrieval_units_v2 r WHERE r.snapshot_id = #{snapshotId} AND r.container_ref = #{containerRef} AND r.returnable = TRUE AND r.structural_context IS NOT NULL AND r.structural_context != '' ORDER BY r.representation_id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT snapshot_id, asset_ref, asset_type, table_ref, columns_json::text AS columns_json, row_count, readiness, schema_version FROM asset_structured_assets WHERE snapshot_id = #{snapshotId} AND asset_ref = #{assetRef}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM asset_table_cells WHERE snapshot_id = #{snapshotId} AND table_ref = #{tableRef}

SELECT t.row_index AS rowIndex, t.cells::text AS cellsJson FROM ( SELECT c.row_index, jsonb_object_agg(c.column_name, c.value) AS cells FROM asset_table_cells c WHERE c.snapshot_id = #{snapshotId} AND c.table_ref = #{tableRef} AND c.is_header = FALSE GROUP BY c.row_index ) t
ORDER BY
NULLIF(REPLACE(t.cells ->> #{orderField}, ',', ''), '')::numeric
t.cells ->> #{orderField}
DESC ASC
, t.row_index ASC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT c.row_index, jsonb_object_agg(c.column_name, c.value) AS cells FROM asset_table_cells c WHERE c.snapshot_id = #{snapshotId} AND c.table_ref = #{tableRef} AND c.is_header = FALSE GROUP BY c.row_index ) t

SELECT
COUNT(*)
SUM(NULLIF(REPLACE(t.cells ->> #{aggField}, ',', ''), '')::numeric)
MIN(NULLIF(REPLACE(t.cells ->> #{aggField}, ',', ''), '')::numeric)
MAX(NULLIF(REPLACE(t.cells ->> #{aggField}, ',', ''), '')::numeric)
AVG(NULLIF(REPLACE(t.cells ->> #{aggField}, ',', ''), '')::numeric)
AS value FROM ( SELECT c.row_index, jsonb_object_agg(c.column_name, c.value) AS cells FROM asset_table_cells c WHERE c.snapshot_id = #{snapshotId} AND c.table_ref = #{tableRef} AND c.is_header = FALSE GROUP BY c.row_index ) t

SELECT n.snapshot_id, n.ref, n.parent_ref, n.ordinal, n.block_type, s.raw_text, s.token_count, s.section_path::text AS heading_chain_json FROM asset_structure_nodes n JOIN asset_raw_segments s ON s.document_snapshot_id = n.snapshot_id AND s.segment_index = n.ordinal WHERE n.snapshot_id = #{snapshotId} AND n.node_type = 'segment' AND n.ordinal > #{afterIndex} ORDER BY n.ordinal ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT snapshot_id, node_type, ref, parent_ref, ordinal, title, level, block_type FROM asset_structure_nodes WHERE snapshot_id = #{snapshotId} AND node_type = 'section' ORDER BY ref ASC LIMIT #{limit}
